title: Army Museum

services.name: Our Exhibits
services.desc: As you enter the museum, you are immersed in the beginning of the modern Canadian military with exhibits telling the story of the First World War. Moving through to the third room in the museum visitors learn the story of Canada in the Second World War. In the final room, visitors will learn about missions Canada has participated in since the Korean War. Also featured are the active units of 36 Brigade and their history. Army Museum Halifax Citadel2nd Floor Cavalier Building5425 Sackville St.Halifax, Nova ScotiaB3J

blurb: Since 1953, the Army Museum Halifax Citadel has fascinated and inspired thousands of visitors from around the world. Housed in an actual military fortress, the museum tells the powerful and compelling stories of the soldiers of Nova Scotia. From munitions to medals, and from service to sacrifice, no detail is spared.
